## List All Accounts for an Identity

Use `GET /v3/accounts` filtered by `identityId`. This returns every account across all connected sources that ISC has correlated to the given identity.

### Request

```http
GET /v3/accounts?filters=identityId+eq+%22{identityId}%22
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

### Example (curl)

```bash
TENANT="your-tenant"
IDENTITY_ID="2c9180857182305e0171993735622948"
TOKEN="your_access_token"

curl -s -X GET \
  "https://${TENANT}.api.identitynow.com/v3/accounts?filters=identityId%20eq%20%22${IDENTITY_ID}%22&count=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
```

### Example (Python — with pagination)

```python
import requests

tenant = "your-tenant"
token = "your_access_token"
identity_id = "2c9180857182305e0171993735622948"

base_url = f"https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/accounts"
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

params = {
    "filters": f'identityId eq "{identity_id}"',
    "limit": 250,
    "offset": 0,
    "count": True,
}

accounts = []
while True:
    resp = requests.get(base_url, headers=headers, params=params)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    batch = resp.json()
    accounts.extend(batch)
    if len(batch) < params["limit"]:
        break
    params["offset"] += params["limit"]

for acct in accounts:
    print(f"{acct['sourceName']:30s}  {acct['name']:30s}  {acct['id']}")
```

### Key notes

| Detail | Value |
|---|---|
| Filter field | `identityId` — the `id` of the identity object |
| Pagination | Use `limit` + `offset`; set `count=true` to get `X-Total-Count` header for total |
| Detail level | Default is `FULL`; pass `detailLevel=SLIM` for a lighter payload |
| Required scope | `idn:accounts:read` (read-only) or `idn:accounts:manage` |
| User levels | `ORG_ADMIN`, `SOURCE_ADMIN`, `SOURCE_SUBADMIN`, `HELPDESK` |

Each returned account object includes `sourceName`, `sourceId`, `name` (account name on the source), `nativeIdentity`, `attributes`, and correlated identity info — giving you the full picture across every connected source.
